gallery.title: Achievements
gallery.subtitle: Your collection of milestones — they unlock on their own as you use Manifiesto.
gallery.empty: You'll be able to unlock achievements soon.

hero.subEmpty: Start using Manifiesto and they'll unlock on their own.
hero.subComplete: You've got them all! You're a legend.
hero.subHalf: You're past the halfway mark. Unstoppable.

badgeDetail.lockedHint: It unlocks on its own once you earn it.

floracion.hint: No noise: we'll tell you about the milestone just once.

first_cycle_under_budget.title: Month to spare
first_cycle_under_budget.body: You closed your first cycle spending less. Real margin, in your pocket.

first_expense.title: The first sprout
first_expense.body: You logged your first expense. From today on, nothing slips by.

first_fixed.title: The month's frame
first_fixed.body: Your first fixed expense logged: now you know what goes out no matter what.

first_goal.title: You gave it a name
first_goal.body: Your first goal has a direction. Saving toward something changes everything.

first_paid_fixed.title: Bill settled
first_paid_fixed.body: You paid your first fixed expense and logged it. Mind at ease.

goal_25.title: First quarter
goal_25.body: A quarter of your goal, saved up. Getting started was the hard part.

goal_50.title: Halfway and climbing
goal_50.body: Half is already yours. From here you can see the top.

goal_75.title: Almost in hand
goal_75.body: Three quarters. The goal stopped being just an idea.

goal_completed.title: Goal in bloom
goal_completed.body: You made it all the way. What you planned turned into money.

no_spend_cycle_15.title: Half-cycle zen
no_spend_cycle_15.body: Fifteen quiet days. Half the month, at peace.

no_spend_cycle_3.title: Three calm days
no_spend_cycle_3.body: Three no-spend days in a cycle. Holding back is a skill too.

no_spend_cycle_7.title: Serene week
no_spend_cycle_7.body: Seven no-spend days in the cycle. It's a rhythm now.

no_spend_lifetime_50.title: Fifty without spending
no_spend_lifetime_50.body: 50 no-spend days since you started. A holding-back veteran.

streak_14.title: Two weeks standing
streak_14.body: Fourteen steady days. It's no longer effort, it's habit.

streak_30.title: A month without missing
streak_30.body: 30 days in a row. This has taken root.

streak_60.title: Two months deep-rooted
streak_60.body: 60 days. Consistency now has a trunk of its own.

streak_7.title: Seven in a row
streak_7.body: A week without skipping one. The habit is showing.

streak_90.title: Living legend
streak_90.body: 90 days without missing one. This is just who you are now.
